sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 360. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
